scripts.dev:server: npm run docker:up && npm run docker:logs
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run setup:client && npm run setup:server && npm run setup:env
scripts.setup:server: cd server && python3 -m venv venv && . venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.setup:env: cp web/.env.example web/.env && cp server/.env.example server/.env
scripts.docker:nuke: docker compose -f server/docker-compose.yml down -v --rmi all && docker system prune -a -f --volumes
scripts.db:makemigrations: docker compose -f server/docker-compose.yml exec backend python manage.py makemigrations
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose -f server/docker-compose.yml exec backend python manage.py migrate
scripts.db:seed: docker compose -f server/docker-compose.yml exec backend python manage.py loaddata seed.json
scripts.db:superuser: docker compose -f server/docker-compose.yml exec backend python manage.py createsuperuser
scripts.db:shell: docker compose -f server/docker-compose.yml exec backend python manage.py shell
scripts.test: npm run test:client && npm run test:server
scripts.test:server: docker compose -f server/docker-compose.yml exec backend pytest
scripts.ml:setup: cd ML && python3 -m venv venv && . venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt && python scripts/train_models.py
